name: transit-visa-check
title: Transit Visa Check
description: Layover check against starter airport transit visa lists (UK, Germany, France, Netherlands; US has no airside transit) and border-entry traps (self-transfer, onward Schengen flight, UK to Ireland, leaving the airport), with exempting documents and official links.

meta.stops: Stranded at a layover without a visa
meta.summary: Flags layovers that may need a transit visa for the traveller's passport, and the itinerary traps that force them through the border.
catches: Nationalities on a country's airport transit visa list
Documents that commonly exempt (e.g. valid US/CA/UK visas, EEA residence)
Self-transfers and separate tickets that mean collecting bags and entering
An onward flight to another Schengen country, which means entering here
UK to Ireland and leaving the airport during the layover
limits: Starter rules for a few countries only; it is not a visa determination
Visa lists and exemptions change; each rule carries its own checked date
Airlines decide boarding: confirm with Timatic, the airline or the official source
a11y: Section labelled by its heading; every input and document checkbox has a <label>
Verdict in a polite live region with icon and text
Official and Timatic links have visible text

rules.note: Nationality lists carry a checked date of 2026-10-14 from a previous round but were not re-verified this round (official pages blocked automated fetches). GOV.UK confirms the DATV/Visitor in Transit split and the visitor-visa exemption. Informational; always confirm with Timatic or the official source.
